scripts.build: npm run build:cloud && npm run build:document
scripts.dev: npm run build:dev && npm run copy:base
scripts.prod: npm run clean:prod && npm run lint && npm run build:prod && npm run verify:publish
scripts.build:cloud:dev: npm run build:cloud && npm run bundle:dev && npm run copy:base
scripts.build:document:dev: npm run build:document && npm run bundle:dev && npm run copy:base
scripts.publish:dev: npm run publish:dev:cloud && npm run publish:dev:document
scripts.publish:prod: npm run publish:prod:cloud && npm run publish:prod:document
scripts.publish:dev:cloud: cd publish/ibm && npm publish --dry-run && cd ../minio && npm publish --dry-run
scripts.publish:prod:cloud: cd publish/ibm && npm publish && cd ../minio && npm publish
scripts.publish:dev:document: cd publish/clean-css && npm publish --dry-run && cd ../csso && npm publish --dry-run && cd ../html-minifier-next && npm publish --dry-run && cd ../html-minifier-terser && npm publish --dry-run && cd ../svgo && npm publish --dry-run && cd ../uglify-js && npm publish --dry-run
scripts.publish:prod:document: cd publish/clean-css && npm publish && cd ../csso && npm publish && cd ../html-minifier-next && npm publish && cd ../html-minifier-terser && npm publish && cd ../svgo && npm publish && cd ../uglify-js && npm publish
scripts.bundle:dev: npx admin strip -s -f client -S "@pi-r2/" -P ./publish ./src/cloud ./build && npx admin strip -s -S "@pi-r2/" -P -F ./publish ./src/document ./build && npm run bundle:exports && npm run copy:types
scripts.bundle:dev:check: npx admin strip -s -f client -S "@pi-r2/" -c ./scripts/checksum.cloud.csv -P ./publish ./src/cloud ./build && npx admin strip -s -S "@pi-r2/" -c ./scripts/checksum.document.csv -P -F ./publish ./src/document ./build && npm run bundle:exports && npm run copy:types
scripts.bundle:prod: npx admin strip -f client -S "@pi-r2/" -c ./scripts/checksum.cloud.csv -P ./publish ./src/cloud ./build && npx admin strip -S "@pi-r2/" -c ./scripts/checksum.document.csv -P -F ./publish ./src/document ./build && npm run bundle:exports && npm run copy:types
scripts.clean:prod: npm run clean && npx admin remove -E js -s publish
